posts.title: Git commit based reproducible builds with Maven
posts.description: I’ve been working on making my Maven builds byte-for-byte reproducible. This is generally pretty straightforward, and is documented on the Maven site . The short of it is that you need to specify an output timestamp in the POM, which lets Maven use that fixed point in time as the creation/modification timestamp for the files in your artifacts.
